message: 家宰の人

name: Paqy
message: 「Coming all the way to the library to study on a Sunday... Being a scholarship student sure is tough.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not it. Last night, the Crusaders fought some ridiculously strong Demons, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Thinking about what comes next, I wanted to check the library again to see if there are any books with detailed info on Demons.」

name: Paqy
message: 「...At the end of the day, that's still studying.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Umuun, my hand can't reach.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Would it be this book here, my lady?」
Oh? Lolotte is visiting the library too. Is she looking for books on Demons just like me?

name: Lolotte
message: 「Jiiya, the one right next to it... Yes, that one. Please get '100 Hacks for Meteor Managers: Reconciliation Edition' for me.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Leave any bookshelf too high for my lady's reach to me, your butler, Riesling Tooyama.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Isn't that the how-to book section?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hoeh? Hello there, Mr. President.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey... Wait, you're borrowing something pretty unusual for you, aren't you, Lolotte?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Believe it or not! This isn't the only book. Right, Jiiya?」

name: Riesling
message: 「We also have 'The Road to Truce: Collection of World Mediation Treaties - Practical Application Edition.'」

name: Lolotte
message: 「On top of that, there are even romance novels from the 'Mr. Pierrot Series' that the Vice President recommended to me.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Apparently, they're all stories where couples fight and break up ninety percent of the time, only to get back together one hundred percent of the time.」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-The genres are all over the place, so you have quite a wide taste in reading, huh, Lolotte?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「...That's not it...」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte?」
Seeing Lolotte suddenly look so downhearted, I realize the common thread.
Reconciliation, mediation, getting back together--

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte, you're looking for books that explain how to make up with someone, aren't you?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「*Flinch*!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Choose your words a little more carefully, Master Synn」

name: Synn
message: 「There's no point sugarcoating it when no such book exists」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hiiyaaa!! I-Is that true!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Listen, Lolotte... Doing just one thing to fix your relationship with them... things don't work like that」

name: Synn
message: 「Try thinking back, okay? Didn't your relationship change because of lots of little things piling up over time?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Y-Yes...」

name: Synn
message: 「Unfortunately, that's as far as I can help you figure out」

name: Synn
message: 「If you want to make up, you shouldn't rely on weird books--you're better off thinking it through yourself, Lolotte」

name: Synn
message: 「After all, the one who knows that person best is supposed to be you, Lolotte」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I-I understand... Still, President, please let me hear more of what you have to say」

name: Synn
message: 「Sure, if you don't mind what little I can offer」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, we shouldn't just stand around talking. Let's head over to the study corner」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hieek!? The competition for seats over there is fierce! I'll go ahead and save us a spot!」

name: Synn
message: 「I've had so many people give me a push forward」

name: Synn
message: 「Everything I just told Lolotte is really just secondhand quotes of things those people once said to me」

name: Riesling
message: 「I, Riesling Toyama, could also have taught the young lady...」

name: Riesling
message: 「If reading a person's psychological state from the gestures they unconsciously make would have sufficed, I could have instructed her, however...」

name: Synn
message: 「Whether the meaning behind human gestures applies to an angel's... even I don't know」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, even if Lolotte were dealing with a human... you would deliberately refrain from giving her concrete methods anyway, wouldn't you, Riesling?」

name: Riesling
message: 「You flatter me」

name: Synn
message: 「I think I understand how you feel. I'll go talk to her as if I were Lolotte's butler myself」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Jiiya! President! I got us a spot, hurry over~」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa, shouting like that inside the building--」
I hurriedly trotted over to Lolotte. Even at a time like this, Riesling-san walked with a graceful, stylish stride.
